name: SmartSpectra
description:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SmartSpectra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SmartSpectra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.presagetech.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SmartSpectra MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SmartSpectra provides these MCP tools: api_keys.get, api_keys.rotate, apps.delete, apps.get_config, apps.list, apps.register, docs.map, docs.read, docs.search, and usage.get_plan.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SmartSpectra?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SmartSpectra in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
SmartSpectra requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SmartSpectra is developed by Presage Tech. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
